orientation: inside half: rotation 0, outward is UP: the core sits on the floor with its top 4px overhanging the inner wall face (see offset); cable plugs into the power coupling
notes: Concord Afterburner (engine, standard, tier 2, unique), a hull mount (outward is up). OUTSIDE: one big reheat can on the Concord nacelle plate, its tail heat-tinted in straw and brown bands, an amber Mk2 collar ring, a ring of fuel injectors under the mouth and an iris of petals round it; the exhaust plume (glow) is long, with shock diamonds. INSIDE: the air intake that burns the engine room's air: a big louvred fan cowl whose blades turn, with the room air drawn toward it (pale dashes); the manned console (a throttle lever and a screen), a warning plate with a helmet (man it in a suit), a fuel tank on its feed line, the repair hatch and the power coupling. Damaged: two petals blown off the iris and the can cracked and sputtering; inside, a fan blade gone (the fan wobbles), the tank weeps fuel, the console red. Disabled: the can bent over and scorched, the iris jammed; inside the fan dead with its cowl split, the tank split, the console dark. THIS FILE: the INSIDE half (core, power coupling, repair hatch; its top 4px overhang the inner wall face as a flange).
